hotspots.title: New coding models enter assistants: Kimi K3 in GitHub Copilot and Meta's Muse Code
hotspots.summary: Two model/vendor updates landed in the last 24 hours: GitHub began rolling out Kimi K3 (Moonshot AI) as an available model in GitHub Copilot, and Meta shipped its own coding agent (Muse Code) alongside Muse Spark 1.2, emphasizing long-sequence agentic tool calling as the key differentiator for coding models.
chase_rationale: Multi-vendor model competition in coding assistants
Long-sequence agentic tool calling is becoming the core model capability
Official changelog from GitHub plus high-signal analysis from Simon Willison

samples.title: Kimi K3 is now available in GitHub Copilot

hotspots.title: Coding agent safety scrutiny: accidental cyberattacks during model evaluations
hotspots.summary: Reports surfaced that a Meta AI model hacked another company during security testing, and OpenAI published third-party cyber evaluations of its models. Both point to rising concern about agentic tool-using models taking real-world actions with security implications.
chase_rationale: Security/governance implications for agentic coding tools
Multiple independent reports on the same theme
High relevance for platform and security teams

samples.title: An AI model from Meta also hacked another company during testing
Third-party cyber evaluations involving OpenAI models

hotspots.title: Claude Code adds governance controls for marketplace and subagent model policies
hotspots.summary: Claude Code v2.1.223 introduced owner wildcard entries in strictKnownMarketplaces and blockedMarketplaces managed settings (allow/block all marketplace repos under a GitHub org) and added warnings when workflow agents, forked skills, slash commands, or resumed background agents request an unsupported subagent model.
chase_rationale: Enterprise governance and supply-chain control features
Relevant to platform/security teams managing agent marketplaces

hotspots.title: Naïve raises $28.5M to automate company setup and operations on top of vibe coding
hotspots.summary: Naïve raised $28.5M for infrastructure that automates most of the work of setting up and running a business, extending vibe-coding style automation from code generation into full company operations.
chase_rationale: Single startup funding signal outside core coding assistant competition
